name: meteo-ai-app
description: Web app meteo italiana con backend FastAPI, ML server-side e frontend statico su Netlify

scripts.dev:backend: cross-env APP_ENV=development FRONTEND_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8888 DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///meteo-backend/meteo_ai.db ENABLE_SCHEDULER=false AUTO_LOAD_CITIES=false python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir meteo-backend
scripts.dev:backend:full: cross-env APP_ENV=development FRONTEND_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8888 DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///meteo-backend/meteo_ai.db ENABLE_SCHEDULER=true AUTO_LOAD_CITIES=true python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir meteo-backend
